stages.change: Removed the action-page break, used a plain metric, lowered cell padding, rebalanced the figure row, and added bars to three observation cells.

findings.evidence: The forced page starts the action section on page 3. The ledger leaves much of page 2 unused and the action illustration occupies only the upper portion of page 3.
findings.correction: Remove the explicit break and use a smaller paired image and compact component spacing.
findings.result: The route ledger, action notes and captioned image share page 2. The cover retains its own space.

findings.evidence: A dark rectangle and then a light rectangle each claim a major entry point on the same page.
findings.correction: Choose an unshaded heading and plain display metric; retain a lighter surface for table and metadata cues.
findings.result: The metric, ledger and action heading form distinct stops without stacked panels.

findings.evidence: The three route observations are exact but need individual number reading to compare relative volumes.
findings.correction: Add one bar series derived from the three observations and exclude the total.
findings.result: The 96, 78 and 66 cells retain editable numbers and have independently verified proportional strokes. The total remains unmarked.

findings.evidence: The revised cover leaves a lower band of white paper after the panoramic caption.
findings.correction: Keep the dedicated cover so the title, identifying text, panorama and caption read as one introduction.
findings.result: The working review accepts the deliberate cover interval.
